from nltk.tree import Tree

AUG_OUTPUT_STOCHASTIC = True

_tokenizer = TreebankWordTokenizer()
_detokenizer = TreebankWordDetokenizer()

_POS_MAP = {
    "NN": wn.NOUN,
    "NNS": wn.NOUN,
    "NNP": wn.NOUN,
    "NNPS": wn.NOUN,
    "VB": wn.VERB,
    "VBD": wn.VERB,
    "VBG": wn.VERB,
    "VBN": wn.VERB,
    "VBP": wn.VERB,
    "VBZ": wn.VERB,
    "JJ": wn.ADJ,
    "JJR": wn.ADJ,
    "JJS": wn.ADJ,
    "RB": wn.ADV,
    "RBR": wn.ADV,
    "RBS": wn.ADV,
}

_PROTECTED = {"not", "n't", "no", "never"}


def _named_entity_indices(tagged_tokens):
    tree = nltk.ne_chunk(tagged_tokens, binary=False)
    named = set()

    def visit(node, index, in_entity=False):
        if isinstance(node, Tree):
            entity = in_entity or node.label() not in {"S", "ROOT"}
            for child in node:
                index = visit(child, index, entity)
            return index
        if in_entity:
            named.add(index)
        return index + 1

    visit(tree, 0)
    return named


def _synonyms(token, wordnet_pos):
    values = set()
    for synset in wn.synsets(token, pos=wordnet_pos):
        for lemma in synset.lemmas():
            value = lemma.name().replace("_", " ")
            if value.lower() != token.lower() and value.lower() not in _PROTECTED:
                values.add(value)
    return list(values)


def _augment_utterance(utterance):
    tokens = _tokenizer.tokenize(utterance)
    tagged = nltk.pos_tag(tokens)
    named_indices = _named_entity_indices(tagged)
    candidates = []

    for index, (token, tag) in enumerate(tagged):
        wordnet_pos = _POS_MAP.get(tag)
        if (
            wordnet_pos is not None
            and tag[:2] in {"NN", "VB", "JJ", "RB"}
            and token.lower() not in _PROTECTED
            and index not in named_indices
        ):
            synonyms = _synonyms(token, wordnet_pos)
            if synonyms:
                candidates.append((index, synonyms))

    if not candidates:
        return []

    replacement_count = min(max(1, int(len(candidates) * 0.2)), 8)
    copies = []
    seen = set()
    attempts = 0

    while len(copies) < 3 and attempts < 100:
        attempts += 1
        selected = random.sample(candidates, min(replacement_count, len(candidates)))
        rewritten = list(tokens)

        for index, synonyms in selected:
            rewritten[index] = random.choice(synonyms)

        text = _detokenizer.detokenize(rewritten)
        if text not in seen and text != utterance:
            seen.add(text)
            copies.append(text)

    return copies


def aug_code(train_data):
    augmented = list(train_data)

    for record in train_data:
        rewritten_utterances = _augment_utterance(record["utterance"])
        for utterance in rewritten_utterances:
            rewritten = dict(record)
            rewritten["utterance"] = utterance
            augmented.append(rewritten)

    return augmented

import torch
from transformers import AutoModelForMaskedLM, AutoTokenizer

AUG_OUTPUT_STOCHASTIC = True

def _is_excluded_token(token, protected_tokens):
    token = token[2:] if token.startswith("##") else token
    if token in protected_tokens:
        return True
    return bool(token) and all(character in string.punctuation for character in token)

def _rewrite_utterance(utterance, tokenizer, model, device, mask_ratio, top_k, max_seq_len, protected_tokens):
    encoded = tokenizer(
        utterance,
        return_tensors="pt",
        truncation=True,
        max_length=max_seq_len,
    )
    encoded = {key: value.to(device) for key, value in encoded.items()}
    input_ids = encoded["input_ids"]
    tokens = tokenizer.convert_ids_to_tokens(input_ids[0].tolist())
    special_ids = set(tokenizer.all_special_ids)

    eligible = [
        index
        for index, token_id in enumerate(input_ids[0].tolist())
        if token_id not in special_ids
        and not _is_excluded_token(tokens[index], protected_tokens)
    ]

    if not eligible:
        return utterance

    mask_count = max(1, int(round(len(eligible) * mask_ratio)))
    mask_count = min(mask_count, len(eligible))
    selected = torch.randperm(len(eligible), device=device)[:mask_count]
    selected_positions = [eligible[index] for index in selected.tolist()]

    masked_ids = input_ids.clone()
    masked_ids[0, selected_positions] = tokenizer.mask_token_id

    with torch.no_grad():
        logits = model(
            input_ids=masked_ids,
            attention_mask=encoded.get("attention_mask"),
            token_type_ids=encoded.get("token_type_ids"),
        ).logits

    rewritten_ids = input_ids.clone()

    for position in selected_positions:
        candidate_count = min(top_k, logits.shape[-1])
        top_logits, top_ids = torch.topk(logits[0, position], candidate_count)
        valid = top_ids != input_ids[0, position]
        candidate_logits = top_logits[valid]
        candidate_ids = top_ids[valid]

        if candidate_ids.numel() > 0:
            probabilities = torch.softmax(candidate_logits, dim=0)
            sampled_index = torch.multinomial(probabilities, 1)
            rewritten_ids[0, position] = candidate_ids[sampled_index]

    return tokenizer.decode(
        rewritten_ids[0],
        skip_special_tokens=True,
        clean_up_tokenization_spaces=True,
    )

    device = torch.device("cuda" if torch.cuda.is_available() else "cpu")
    tokenizer = AutoTokenizer.from_pretrained("bert-base-uncased")
    model = AutoModelForMaskedLM.from_pretrained("bert-base-uncased").to(device)
    model.eval()

    augmented = list(train_data)

    for record in train_data:
        for _ in range(2):
            rewritten = dict(record)
            rewritten["utterance"] = _rewrite_utterance(

import difflib
import torch
from transformers import AutoTokenizer, AutoModelForCausalLM

AUG_OUTPUT_STOCHASTIC = True

_MODEL_NAME = "Qwen/Qwen2.5-0.5B-Instruct"
_DEVICE = torch.device("cuda" if torch.cuda.is_available() else "cpu")
_TOKENIZER = AutoTokenizer.from_pretrained(_MODEL_NAME)
_MODEL = AutoModelForCausalLM.from_pretrained(_MODEL_NAME).to(_DEVICE)
_MODEL.eval()


def _percentile(values, percentile):
    ordered = sorted(values)
    position = (len(ordered) - 1) * percentile
    lower = int(position)
    upper = min(lower + 1, len(ordered))
    fraction = position - lower
    return ordered[lower] + (ordered[upper] - ordered[lower]) * fraction


def _prompt(messages):
    return _TOKENIZER.apply_chat_template(
        messages,
        tokenize=False,
        add_generation_prompt=True,
    )


def _generate(messages, temperature, max_new_tokens):
    prompt = _prompt(messages)
    encoded = _TOKENIZER(prompt, return_tensors="pt").to(_DEVICE)
    with torch.no_grad():
        generated = _MODEL.generate(
            **encoded,
            do_sample=True,
            temperature=temperature,
            max_new_tokens=max_new_tokens,
            pad_token_id=_TOKENIZER.eos_token_id,
        )
    continuation = generated[0, encoded["input_ids"].shape[1]:]
    return _TOKENIZER.decode(continuation, skip_special_tokens=True).strip(), prompt


def _similarity(left, right):
    return difflib.SequenceMatcher(None, left, right).ratio()


def aug_code(train_data):
    augmented = list(train_data)
    original_utterances = [row["utterance"] for row in train_data]
    generated_utterances = []
    utterance_lengths = [len(row["utterance"].split()) for row in train_data]
    max_length = 2.0 * _percentile(utterance_lengths, 0.95)

    label_counts = {}
    for row in train_data:
        label_counts[row["sarcasm"]] = label_counts.get(row["sarcasm"], 0) + 1
    labels = list(label_counts)
    weights = [label_counts[label] / len(train_data) for label in labels]

    exemplars = train_data[: min(4, len(train_data))]

    for row in train_data:
        exemplar_text = "\n".join(
            f"Context: {ex['context']}\nSpeaker: {ex['speaker']}\n"
            f"Utterance: {ex['utterance']}\nSarcasm: {ex['sarcasm']}"
            for ex in exemplars
        )

        rewrite_messages = [
            {
                "role": "system",
                "content": "You write concise sitcom dialogue. Return only the rewritten utterance.",
            },
            {
                "role": "user",
                "content": (
                    f"Few-shot exemplars:\n{exemplar_text}\n\n"
                    f"Context: {row['context']}\n"
                    f"Context speakers: {row['context_speakers']}\n"
                    f"Speaker: {row['speaker']}\n"
                    f"Utterance: {row['utterance']}\n"
                    f"Sarcasm label: {row['sarcasm']}\n\n"
                    "Rewrite the utterance while preserving the speaker voice, "
                    "communicative intent, and sarcasm label. Return one rewrite only."
                ),
            },
        ]
        rewrite, rewrite_prompt = _generate(rewrite_messages, 0.9, 60)

        novel_label = random.choices(labels, weights=weights, k=1)[0]
        novel_messages = [
            {
                "role": "system",
                "content": "You write plausible sitcom dialogue in a TV-show register. Return only one utterance.",
            },
            {
                "role": "user",
                "content": (
                    f"Context: {row['context']}\n"
                    f"Context speakers: {row['context_speakers']}\n"
                    f"Speaker: {row['speaker']}\n"
                    f"Required sarcasm label: {novel_label}\n\n"
                    "Write a NEW plausible next turn for this speaker and context. "
                    "Make the label-consistent dialogue sound natural and return one utterance only."
                ),
            },
        ]
        novel, novel_prompt = _generate(novel_messages, 1.0, 60)

        for text, prompt, label in (
            (rewrite, rewrite_prompt, row["sarcasm"]),
            (novel, novel_prompt, novel_label),
        ):
            if not text:
                continue
            if len(text.split()) > max_length:
                continue
            if prompt in text or text in prompt:
                continue
            if any(_similarity(text, existing) >= 0.9 for existing in original_utterances + generated_utterances):
                continue
            record = dict(row)
            record["utterance"] = text
            record["sarcasm"] = label
            augmented.append(record)
            generated_utterances.append(text)

    return augmented

    "slow": ["steady", "deliberate"],

}

_POLARITY = {}
for _word in _POSITIVE:
    _POLARITY[_word] = 1
for _word in _NEGATIVE:
    _POLARITY[_word] = -1

def _score(text):
    words = re.findall(r"[A-Za-z']+", text.lower())
    return sum(_POLARITY.get(word, 0) for word in words)

def _replace_case(match, replacement):
    original = match.group(0)
    if original.isupper():
        return replacement.upper()
    if original[:1].isupper():
        return replacement[:1].upper() + replacement[1:]
    return replacement

def _edit(text, positions, replacements):
    parts = []
    cursor = 0
    for start, end, replacement in zip(positions[0], positions[1], replacements):
        parts.append(text[cursor:start])
        parts.append(replacement)
        cursor = end
    parts.append(text[cursor:])
    return "".join(parts)

def _candidates(text, mapping, desired_polarity=None):
    found = []
    for match in re.finditer(r"[A-Za-z']+", text):
        word = match.group(0).lower()
        if word in mapping and (
            desired_polarity is None or _POLARITY.get(word) == desired_polarity
        ):
            found.append((match.start(), match.end(), word))
    return found

    copied = dict(record)
    copied["utterance"] = utterance
    if isinstance(copied.get("context"), list):
        copied["context"] = list(copied["context"])
    if isinstance(copied.get("context_speakers"), list):
        copied["context_speakers"] = list(copied["context_speakers"])
    return copied

def _dedupe_key(record):
    return (
        record["utterance"],
        record["speaker"],
        tuple(record["context"]),
        tuple(record["context_speakers"]),
        record["sarcasm"],
    )

def aug_code(train_data):
    augmented = [dict(record) for record in train_data]

    for record in train_data:
        utterance = record["utterance"]
        context = " ".join(record["context"])
        utterance_score = _score(utterance)
        context_score = _score(context)
        polarity_gap = utterance_score - context_score

        if record["sarcasm"] == 1:
            target = -1 if context_score > 0 else 1 if context_score < 0 else (
                -1 if utterance_score > 0 else 1
            )
            candidates = _candidates(
                utterance,
                _POSITIVE if target > 0 else _NEGATIVE,
                target,
            )
            selected = candidates[:3]

            for _ in range(2):
                replacements = [
                    _replace_case(
                        re.match(r"[A-Za-z']+", utterance[start:end]),
                        random.choice(
                            (_POSITIVE if target > 0 else _NEGATIVE)[word]
                        ),
                    )
                    for start, end, word in selected
                ]
                edited = _edit(
                    utterance,
                    (
                        [item[0] for item in selected],
                        [item[1] for item in selected],
                    ),
                    replacements,
                )
                if random.random() < 0.5:
                    marker = "absolutely" if target > 0 else "utterly"
                    edited = marker + " " + edited
                augmented.append(_record_copy(record, edited))
        else:
            candidates = _candidates(utterance, _NEUTRAL)
            selected = candidates[:3]

            for _ in range(2):
                replacements = [
                    _replace_case(
                        re.match(r"[A-Za-z']+", utterance[start:end]),
                        random.choice(_NEUTRAL[word]),
                    )
                    for start, end, word in selected
                ]
                edited = _edit(
                    utterance,
                    (
                        [item[0] for item in selected],
                        [item[1] for item in selected],
                    ),
                    replacements,
                )
                augmented.append(_record_copy(record, edited))

    unique = []
    seen = set()
    for record in augmented:
        key = _dedupe_key(record)
        if key not in seen:
            seen.add(key)
            unique.append(record)
    return unique

import torch
import torch.nn.functional as F
from transformers import AutoModel, AutoTokenizer

AUG_OUTPUT_STOCHASTIC = True

def _truncate_to_bert_limit(text, tokenizer):
    tokens = tokenizer.encode(text, add_special_tokens=True)
    if len(tokens) <= 128:
        return text
    truncated = tokens[:128]
    return tokenizer.decode(
        truncated,
        skip_special_tokens=True,
        clean_up_tokenization_spaces=False,
    )

def aug_code(train_data):
    augmented = list(train_data)
    if not train_data:
        return augmented

    device = torch.device("cuda" if torch.cuda.is_available() else "cpu")
    tokenizer = AutoTokenizer.from_pretrained("bert-base-uncased")
    model = AutoModel.from_pretrained("bert-base-uncased").to(device)
    model.eval()
    for parameter in model.parameters():
        parameter.requires_grad_(False)

    utterances = [row["utterance"] for row in train_data]
    labels = [row["sarcasm"] for row in train_data]
    encoded = tokenizer(
        utterances,
        padding=True,
        truncation=True,
        max_length=128,
        return_tensors="pt",
    )
    encoded = {key: value.to(device) for key, value in encoded.items()}

    with torch.no_grad():
        hidden = model(**encoded).last_hidden_state
        mask = encoded["attention_mask"].unsqueeze(-1)
        embeddings = (hidden * mask).sum(dim=1) / mask.sum(dim=1).clamp_min(1)
        embeddings = F.normalize(embeddings, p=2, dim=1)

    connectors = ("  ", ", and ", ". ")

    for index, source in enumerate(train_data):
        candidates = [
            row_index
            for row_index, label in enumerate(labels)
            if row_index != index and label == labels[index]
        ]
        if not candidates:
            continue

        candidate_tensor = torch.tensor(candidates, device=device)
        similarities = embeddings[candidate_tensor] @ embeddings[index]
        limit = min(10, len(candidates))
        top_positions = torch.topk(similarities, k=limit, largest=True).indices
        top_neighbors = candidate_tensor[top_positions].tolist()
        seen = set()

        for _ in range(3):
            neighbor_index = top_neighbors[
                int(torch.randint(len(top_neighbors), (1,), device=device).item())
            ]
            connector = connectors[
                int(torch.randint(len(connectors), (1,), device=device).item())
            ]
            key = (neighbor_index, connector)
            if key in seen:
                continue
            seen.add(key)

            composite = source["utterance"] + connector + train_data[neighbor_index]["utterance"]
            record = dict(source)
            record["utterance"] = _truncate_to_bert_limit(composite, tokenizer)
            augmented.append(record)

    return augmented

import random
import torch
import torch.nn.functional as F
from sklearn.svm import LinearSVC
from transformers import AutoModel, AutoModelForSeq2SeqLM, AutoTokenizer

AUG_OUTPUT_STOCHASTIC = True

_BERT_NAME = "bert-base-uncased"
_LLM_NAME = "google/flan-t5-base"


def _bert_embeddings(texts, tokenizer, model, device):
    encoded = tokenizer(
        texts,
        padding=True,
        truncation=True,
        max_length=512,
        return_tensors="pt",
    )
    encoded = {key: value.to(device) for key, value in encoded.items()}
    with torch.inference_mode():
        outputs = model(**encoded)
        if getattr(outputs, "pooler_output", None) is not None:
            embeddings = outputs.pooler_output
        else:
            embeddings = outputs.last_hidden_state[:, 0, :]
    return embeddings


def aug_code(train_data):
    device = torch.device("cuda" if torch.cuda.is_available() else "cpu")

    bert_tokenizer = AutoTokenizer.from_pretrained(_BERT_NAME)
    bert_model = AutoModel.from_pretrained(_BERT_NAME).to(device)
    bert_model.eval()

    llm_tokenizer = AutoTokenizer.from_pretrained(_LLM_NAME)
    llm_model = AutoModelForSeq2SeqLM.from_pretrained(_LLM_NAME).to(device)
    llm_model.eval()

    source_texts = [row["utterance"] for row in train_data]
    source_labels = [int(row["sarcasm"]) for row in train_data]
    source_embeddings = _bert_embeddings(
        source_texts,
        bert_tokenizer,
        bert_model,
        device,
    )

    probe = LinearSVC()
    probe.fit(source_embeddings.detach().cpu().numpy(), source_labels)

    exemplar_rows = random.sample(train_data, 6)
    exemplars = "\n".join(
        f'Example {index + 1} ({int(row["sarcasm"])}): {row["utterance"]}'
        for index, row in enumerate(exemplar_rows)
    )

    augmented = [dict(row) for row in train_data]
    seen_rewrites = set(source_texts)

    for row_index, source_row in enumerate(train_data):
        source_utterance = source_row["utterance"]
        source_label = int(source_row["sarcasm"])
        source_embedding = source_embeddings[row_index].unsqueeze(0)

        accepted = 0
        attempts = 0

        while accepted < 2 and attempts < 6:
            attempts += 1
            prompt = (
                "Rewrite the anchor utterance while preserving its exact meaning, "
                "sarcasm status, and sitcom dialogue register. Do not introduce "
                "new facts or characters. Return only the rewritten utterance.\n\n"
                f"Few-shot style exemplars:\n{exemplars}\n\n"
                f"Anchor utterance:\n{source_utterance}\n\n"
                "Rewritten utterance:"
            )

            encoded = llm_tokenizer(
                prompt,
                return_tensors="pt",
                truncation=True,
                max_length=1024,
            )
            encoded = {key: value.to(device) for key, value in encoded.items()}

            with torch.inference_mode():
                generated = llm_model.generate(
                    **encoded,
                    do_sample=True,
                    temperature=0.7,
                    max_new_tokens=128,
                )

            rewritten = llm_tokenizer.decode(
                generated[0],
                skip_special_tokens=True,
            ).strip()

            if rewritten in seen_rewrites:
                continue

            rewritten_embedding = _bert_embeddings(
                [rewritten],
                bert_tokenizer,
                bert_model,
                device,
            )
            predicted_label = int(
                probe.predict(rewritten_embedding.detach().cpu().numpy())[0]
            )
            similarity = F.cosine_similarity(
                source_embedding,
                rewritten_embedding,
                dim=1,
            ).item()

            if predicted_label != source_label or similarity < 0.75:
                continue

            generated_row = dict(source_row)
            generated_row["utterance"] = rewritten
            generated_row["sarcasm"] = source_label
            augmented.append(generated_row)
            seen_rewrites.add(rewritten)
            accepted += 1

    return augmented

import torch
from transformers import AutoModelForSeq2SeqLM, AutoTokenizer

AUG_OUTPUT_STOCHASTIC = False

_MODEL_CACHE = {}

def _get_model(pivot):
    if pivot not in _MODEL_CACHE:
        device = torch.device("cuda" if torch.cuda.is_available() else "cpu")
        forward_name = f"Helsinki-NLP/opus-mt-en-{pivot}"
        backward_name = f"Helsinki-NLP/opus-mt-{pivot}-en"
        forward_tokenizer = AutoTokenizer.from_pretrained(forward_name)
        forward_model = AutoModelForSeq2SeqLM.from_pretrained(forward_name).to(device)
        backward_tokenizer = AutoTokenizer.from_pretrained(backward_name)
        backward_model = AutoModelForSeq2SeqLM.from_pretrained(backward_name).to(device)
        forward_model.eval()
        backward_model.eval()
        _MODEL_CACHE[pivot] = (
            forward_tokenizer,
            forward_model,
            backward_tokenizer,
            backward_model,
            device,
        )
    return _MODEL_CACHE[pivot]

def _translate(text, pivot):
    (
        forward_tokenizer,
        forward_model,
        backward_tokenizer,
        backward_model,
        device,
    ) = _get_model(pivot)

    forward_inputs = forward_tokenizer(
        [text],
        return_tensors="pt",
        truncation=True,
        max_length=512,
    ).to(device)

    with torch.no_grad():
        pivot_tokens = forward_model.generate(
            **forward_inputs,
            num_beams=4,
            max_new_tokens=512,
        )

    pivot_text = forward_tokenizer.batch_decode(
        pivot_tokens,
        skip_special_tokens=True,
    )[0]

    backward_inputs = backward_tokenizer(
        [pivot_text],
        return_tensors="pt",
        truncation=True,
        max_length=512,
    ).to(device)

    with torch.no_grad():
        english_tokens = backward_model.generate(
            **backward_inputs,
            num_beams=4,
            max_new_tokens=512,
        )

    return backward_tokenizer.batch_decode(
        english_tokens,
        skip_special_tokens=True,
    )[0]

def _cue_profile(text):
    lower = text.lower()
    intensifiers = {
        "absolutely", "completely", "especially", "extremely", "incredibly",
        "really", "so", "such", "totally", "very", "quite", "super", "too",
    }
    negations = {
        "ain't", "cannot", "can't", "couldn't", "didn't", "doesn't",
        "don't", "isn't", "mustn't", "never", "no", "not", "nothing",
        "nowhere", "shouldn't", "wasn't", "weren't", "won't", "wouldn't",
    }
    return {
        "intensifiers": {word for word in intensifiers if word in lower.split()},
        "negations": {word for word in negations if word in lower.split()},
        "exclamation": "!" in text,
        "ellipsis": "..." in text,
        "quotes": any(mark in text for mark in ('"', "'", "“", "”", "‘", "’")),
    }

def _preserves_cues(source, candidate):
    source_cues = _cue_profile(source)
    candidate_cues = _cue_profile(candidate)
    if source_cues["intensifiers"] and not candidate_cues["intensifiers"]:
        return False
    if source_cues["negations"] and not candidate_cues["negations"]:
        return False
    if source_cues["exclamation"] and not candidate_cues["exclamation"]:
        return False
    if source_cues["ellipsis"] and not candidate_cues["ellipsis"]:
        return False
    if source_cues["quotes"] and not candidate_cues["quotes"]:
        return False
    return True

def aug_code(train_data):
    augmented = [dict(record) for record in train_data]

    for record in train_data:
        source = record["utterance"]
        for pivot in ("fr", "es"):
            candidate = _translate(source, pivot)
            if not _preserves_cues(source, candidate):
                candidate = _translate(source, "de")
            paraphrased = dict(record)
            paraphrased["utterance"] = candidate
            augmented.append(paraphrased)

    return augmented

import copy
import random

from scipy.sparse import hstack
from sklearn.feature_extraction.text import TfidfVectorizer
from sklearn.metrics.pairwise import cosine_similarity


AUG_OUTPUT_STOCHASTIC = True


def aug_code(train_data):
    augmented = [copy.deepcopy(row) for row in train_data]

    context_texts = [" ".join(row["context"]) for row in train_data]
    char_vectorizer = TfidfVectorizer(analyzer="char")
    word_vectorizer = TfidfVectorizer(analyzer="word")
    char_matrix = char_vectorizer.fit_transform(context_texts)
    word_matrix = word_vectorizer.fit_transform(context_texts)
    representations = hstack([char_matrix, word_matrix])
    similarities = cosine_similarity(representations)

    for row_index, row in enumerate(train_data):
        source_context_text = context_texts[row_index]
        candidates = [
            candidate_index
            for candidate_index, candidate_row in enumerate(train_data)
            if candidate_index != row_index
            and candidate_row["sarcasm"] == row["sarcasm"]
            and context_texts[candidate_index] != source_context_text
        ]
        candidates.sort(
            key=lambda candidate_index: (-similarities[row_index, candidate_index], candidate_index)
        )
        candidates = candidates[:15]

        for donor_index in random.sample(candidates, min(3, len(candidates))):
            donor = train_data[donor_index]
            generated = copy.deepcopy(row)
            generated["context"] = list(donor["context"])
            generated["context_speakers"] = list(donor["context_speakers"])
            augmented.append(generated)

    deduplicated = []
    seen = set()
    for row in augmented:
        key = (row["utterance"], tuple(row["context"]))
        if key not in seen:
            seen.add(key)
            deduplicated.append(row)

    return deduplicated

import random

AUG_OUTPUT_STOCHASTIC = True

def _random_derangement(length):
    permutation = list(range(length))
    for index in range(length - 1, 0, -1):
        swap_index = random.randrange(index)
        permutation[index], permutation[swap_index] = (
            permutation[swap_index],
            permutation[index],
        )
    return permutation

def aug_code(train_data):
    augmented = []

    for record in train_data:
        original = dict(record)
        original["context"] = list(record["context"])
        original["context_speakers"] = list(record["context_speakers"])
        augmented.append(original)

        context = record["context"]
        context_speakers = record["context_speakers"]
        turn_count = len(context)
        seen = {record["utterance"], tuple(context)}

        if turn_count >= 2:
            for _ in range(2):
                permutation = _random_derangement(turn_count)
                reordered_context = [context[i] for i in permutation]
                reordered_speakers = [context_speakers[i] for i in permutation]
                key = (record["utterance"], tuple(reordered_context))

                if key not in seen:
                    copy = dict(record)
                    copy["context"] = reordered_context
                    copy["context_speakers"] = reordered_speakers
                    augmented.append(copy)
                    seen.add(key)

        if turn_count >= 3:
            reordered_context = list(reversed(context))
            key = (record["utterance"], tuple(reordered_context))

            if key not in seen:
                copy = dict(record)
                copy["context"] = reordered_context
                copy["context_speakers"] = list(reversed(context_speakers))
                augmented.append(copy)

    return augmented

from sklearn.feature_extraction.text import TfidfVectorizer
from sklearn.cluster import KMeans

AUG_OUTPUT_STOCHASTIC = True

def aug_code(train_data):
    augmented = list(train_data)
    texts = [
        " ".join(list(row["context"]) + [row["utterance"]])
        for row in train_data
    ]

    vectorizer = TfidfVectorizer()
    features = vectorizer.fit_transform(texts)
    clustering = KMeans(n_clusters=8)
    cluster_labels = clustering.fit_predict(features)
    centroids = clustering.cluster_centers_

    label_to_indices = {}
    for index, row in enumerate(train_data):
        label_to_indices.setdefault(row["sarcasm"], []).append(index)

    generated_keys = set()

    for recipient_index, recipient in enumerate(train_data):
        own_cluster = cluster_labels[recipient_index]
        other_clusters = [
            cluster_index
            for cluster_index in range(8)
            if cluster_index != own_cluster
        ]
        distances = [
            (
                cluster_index,
                np.linalg.norm(
                    centroids[own_cluster] - centroids[cluster_index]
                ),
            )
            for cluster_index in other_clusters
        ]
        distances.sort(key=lambda item: item[1], reverse=True)
        farthest_clusters = {
            cluster_index
            for cluster_index, _ in distances[: (len(distances) + 1) // 2]
        }

        candidates = [
            donor_index
            for donor_index in label_to_indices[recipient["sarcasm"]]
            if donor_index != recipient_index
            and cluster_labels[donor_index] in farthest_clusters
        ]

        donor_indices = np.random.choice(
            candidates,
            size=3,
            replace=False,
        )

        for donor_index in donor_indices:
            donor = train_data[int(donor_index)]
            copy = dict(recipient)
            copy["context"] = list(donor["context"])
            copy["context_speakers"] = list(donor["context_speakers"])
            key = (
                copy["utterance"],
                tuple(copy["context"]),
                tuple(copy["context_speakers"]),
            )
            if key not in generated_keys:
                augmented.append(copy)
                generated_keys.add(key)

    return augmented

def _assemble_context(row_index, row, position_bank, label_bank, donor_contexts):
    label = row["sarcasm"]
    source_context = row["context"]
    turn_count = len(source_context)

    for _ in range(6):
        used_donors = set()
        assembled = []
        successful = True

        for position in range(turn_count):
            matched = [
                item for item in position_bank.get((label, position), [])
                if item[0] != row_index and item[0] not in used_donors
            ]
            candidates = matched or [
                item for item in label_bank.get(label, [])
                if item[0] != row_index and item[0] not in used_donors
            ]

            if not candidates:
                successful = False
                break

            donor_index, turn = random.choice(candidates)
            used_donors.add(donor_index)
            assembled.append(turn)

        if successful:
            assembled_key = tuple(assembled)
            if assembled_key != tuple(source_context) and assembled_key not in donor_contexts:
                return assembled

    return None


def aug_code(train_data):
    augmented = list(train_data)
    position_bank = {}
    label_bank = {}
    donor_contexts = set()

    for row_index, row in enumerate(train_data):
        label = row["sarcasm"]
        context = row["context"]
        donor_contexts.add(tuple(context))
        label_bank.setdefault(label, [])
        for position, turn in enumerate(context):
            position_bank.setdefault((label, position), []).append((row_index, turn))
            label_bank[label].append((row_index, turn))

    for row_index, row in enumerate(train_data):
        for _ in range(3):
            context = _assemble_context(
                row_index,

                position_bank,
                label_bank,
                donor_contexts,
            )

                augmented.append(augmented_row)

from copy import deepcopy

AUG_OUTPUT_STOCHASTIC = True

def aug_code(train_data):
    augmented = [deepcopy(record) for record in train_data]
    total_rows = len(train_data)

    if total_rows == 0:
        return augmented

    class_indices = {0: [], 1: []}
    for index, record in enumerate(train_data):
        class_indices[int(bool(record["sarcasm"]))].append(index)

    count_0 = len(class_indices[0])
    count_1 = len(class_indices[1])
    total_copies = 2 * total_rows

    copies_0 = (2 * total_rows + count_1 - count_0) // 2
    copies_1 = total_copies - copies_0

    copies_0 = max(count_0, min(copies_0, total_copies - count_1))
    copies_1 = total_copies - copies_0

    class_budgets = {0: copies_0, 1: copies_1}

    seen_pairs = set()
    for record in augmented:
        seen_pairs.add((record["utterance"], tuple(record["context"])))

    for label in (0, 1):
        indices = class_indices[label]
        if not indices:
            continue

        base_copies, remainder = divmod(class_budgets[label], len(indices))
        donor_pool = indices

        for position, source_index in enumerate(indices):
            row_copies = base_copies + (1 if position < remainder else 0)
            source = train_data[source_index]

            for _ in range(row_copies):
                for _ in range(5):
                    donor_index = random.choice(donor_pool)
                    donor = train_data[donor_index]
                    candidate_pair = (
                        source["utterance"],
                        tuple(donor["context"]),
                    )

                    if candidate_pair in seen_pairs:
                        continue

                    grafted = deepcopy(source)
                    grafted["context"] = list(donor["context"])
                    grafted["context_speakers"] = list(donor["context_speakers"])
                    augmented.append(grafted)
                    seen_pairs.add(candidate_pair)
                    break

    return augmented

AUG_OUTPUT_STOCHASTIC = True

def aug_code(train_data):
    augmented = [copy.deepcopy(record) for record in train_data]
    originals = [copy.deepcopy(record) for record in train_data]

    for recipient in originals:
        same_label = [
            donor for donor in originals
            if donor["sarcasm"] == recipient["sarcasm"]
        ]

        recipient_speaker = recipient["speaker"]
        recipient_cast = set(recipient["context_speakers"])

        primary_pool = [
            donor for donor in same_label
            if donor["context_speakers"]
            and donor["context_speakers"][-1] == recipient_speaker
            and len(recipient_cast.intersection(donor["context_speakers"])) >= 2
        ]

        overlap_one_pool = [
            donor for donor in same_label
            if donor["context_speakers"]
            and donor["context_speakers"][-1] == recipient_speaker
            and len(recipient_cast.intersection(donor["context_speakers"])) >= 1
        ]

        speaker_in_context_pool = [
            donor for donor in same_label
            if recipient_speaker in donor["context_speakers"]
        ]

        if len(primary_pool) >= 3:
            donor_pool = primary_pool
        elif len(overlap_one_pool) >= 3:
            donor_pool = overlap_one_pool
        elif len(speaker_in_context_pool) >= 3:
            donor_pool = speaker_in_context_pool
        else:
            donor_pool = same_label

        existing = {
            (
                record["utterance"],
                record["speaker"],
                tuple(record["context"]),
                tuple(record["context_speakers"]),
                record["sarcasm"],
            )
            for record in augmented
        }

        copies = 0
        attempts = 0
        max_attempts = max(12, len(donor_pool) * 12)

        while copies < 3 and attempts < max_attempts:
            attempts += 1
            donor = random.choice(donor_pool)
            generated = copy.deepcopy(recipient)
            generated["context"] = copy.deepcopy(donor["context"])
            generated["context_speakers"] = copy.deepcopy(donor["context_speakers"])

            key = (
                generated["utterance"],
                generated["speaker"],
                tuple(generated["context"]),
                tuple(generated["context_speakers"]),
                generated["sarcasm"],
            )

            if key not in existing:
                augmented.append(generated)
                existing.add(key)
                copies += 1

    return augmented

import copy
import random

AUG_OUTPUT_STOCHASTIC = True

def aug_code(train_data):
    augmented = [copy.deepcopy(record) for record in train_data]

    lengths = sorted(len(record["context"][i]) for record in train_data for i in range(len(record["context"])))
    if not lengths:
        lengths = [0]

    n = len(lengths)
    q1 = lengths[n // 4]
    q2 = lengths[n // 2]
    q3 = lengths[(3 * n) // 4]

    def length_bucket(length):
        if length <= q1:
            return 0
        if length <= q2:
            return 1
        if length <= q3:
            return 2
        return 3

    structure = []
    for record in train_data:
        context = record["context"]
        structure.append((len(context), sum(len(item) for item in context), length_bucket(sum(len(item) for item in context))))

    fallback_count = 0
    seen = list(augmented)

    for index, record in enumerate(train_data):
        turn_count, context_length, bucket = structure[index]
        same_label = [
            candidate
            for candidate in train_data
            if candidate["sarcasm"] == record["sarcasm"]
        ]

        pool = [
            candidate
            for candidate in same_label
            if abs(len(candidate["context"]) - turn_count) <= 1
            and length_bucket(sum(len(item) for item in candidate["context"])) == bucket
        ]

        if len(pool) < 3:
            fallback_count += 1
            ranked = sorted(
                same_label,
                key=lambda candidate: (
                    abs(len(candidate["context"]) - turn_count),
                    abs(
                        length_bucket(sum(len(item) for item in candidate["context"]))
                        - bucket
                    ),
                ),
            )
            if ranked:
                best_distance = (
                    abs(len(ranked[0]["context"]) - turn_count),
                    abs(
                        length_bucket(sum(len(item) for item in ranked[0]["context"]))
                        - bucket
                    ),
                )
                pool = [
                    candidate
                    for candidate in ranked
                    if (
                        abs(len(candidate["context"]) - turn_count),
                        abs(
                            length_bucket(sum(len(item) for item in candidate["context"]))
                            - bucket
                        ),
                    ) == best_distance
                ]
                if len(pool) < 3:
                    pool = ranked[:3]

        for _ in range(2):
            attempts = 0
            while attempts < max(1, len(pool) * 2):
                donor = random.choice(pool)
                generated = copy.deepcopy(record)
                generated["context"] = copy.deepcopy(donor["context"])
                generated["context_speakers"] = copy.deepcopy(donor["context_speakers"])
                attempts += 1
                if generated not in seen:
                    augmented.append(generated)
                    seen.append(generated)
                    break

    return augmented

import random
from copy import deepcopy

from sklearn.cluster import KMeans
from sklearn.feature_extraction.text import TfidfVectorizer


AUG_OUTPUT_STOCHASTIC = True


def _record_key(record):
    return (
        record["utterance"],
        record["speaker"],
        tuple(record["context"]),
        tuple(record["context_speakers"]),
        record["sarcasm"],
    )


def aug_code(train_data):
    augmented = [deepcopy(record) for record in train_data]
    seen = {_record_key(record) for record in augmented}

    texts = [" ".join(record["context"]) for record in train_data]
    vectorizer = TfidfVectorizer()
    features = vectorizer.fit_transform(texts)

    labels = list(dict.fromkeys(record["sarcasm"] for record in train_data))
    prototypes = {}

    for label in labels:
        indices = [i for i, record in enumerate(train_data) if record["sarcasm"] == label]
        label_features = features[indices]
        clustering = KMeans(n_clusters=4, n_init=10)
        assignments = clustering.fit_predict(label_features)
        label_prototypes = []

        for cluster_id, centroid in enumerate(clustering.cluster_centers_):
            cluster_positions = [
                position
                for position, assignment in enumerate(assignments)
                if assignment == cluster_id
            ]
            medoid_position = min(
                cluster_positions,
                key=lambda position: (
                    ((label_features[position].toarray()[0] - centroid) ** 2).sum(),
                    position,
                ),
            )
            source = train_data[indices[medoid_position]]
            label_prototypes.append(
                (
                    list(source["context"]),
                    list(source["context_speakers"]),
                )
            )

        prototypes[label] = label_prototypes

    for record in train_data:
        eligible = [
            prototype
            for prototype in prototypes[record["sarcasm"]]
            if prototype[0] != record["context"]
        ]
        selected = random.sample(eligible, 3)

        for context, context_speakers in selected:
            augmented_record = deepcopy(record)
            augmented_record["context"] = list(context)
            augmented_record["context_speakers"] = list(context_speakers)
            key = _record_key(augmented_record)
            if key not in seen:
                augmented.append(augmented_record)
                seen.add(key)

    return augmented

import random

def aug_code(train_data):
    augmented = list(train_data)
    seen_copies = set()

    def record_key(record):
        return (
            record["utterance"],
            record["speaker"],
            tuple(record["context"]),
            tuple(record["context_speakers"]),
            record["sarcasm"],
        )

    original_keys = {record_key(record) for record in train_data}
    seen_copies.update(original_keys)

    for record in train_data:
        dropped = dict(record)
        dropped["context"] = []
        dropped["context_speakers"] = []
        dropped_key = record_key(dropped)
        if dropped_key not in seen_copies:
            augmented.append(dropped)
            seen_copies.add(dropped_key)

        if len(record["context"]) > 1:
            index = random.randrange(len(record["context"]))
            single = dict(record)
            single["context"] = [record["context"][index]]
            single["context_speakers"] = [record["context_speakers"][index]]
            single_key = record_key(single)
            if single_key not in seen_copies:
                augmented.append(single)
                seen_copies.add(single_key)

    cap = int(3.0 * len(train_data))
    return augmented[:cap] if len(augmented) > cap else augmented

import random

_EXTERNAL_SNIPPETS = [
    (["Did you finish the report?", "Not yet, I need another hour."], ["d1", "d2"]),
    (["Are you coming to dinner?", "Yes, I will be there soon."], ["d1", "d2"]),
    (["The train is delayed again.", "Then we should take the bus."], ["d1", "d2"]),
    (["I cannot find my keys.", "Check the table by the door.", "They are not there.", "Try your coat pocket."], ["d1", "d2", "d1", "d2"]),
    (["What happened at the meeting?", "Everyone agreed to the proposal.", "That is a relief."], ["d1", "d2", "d1"]),
    (["Please call me later.", "I will call after work.", "Do not forget this time.", "I will remember."], ["d1", "d2", "d1", "d2"]),
    (["The weather looks terrible today.", "We can still go if the rain stops.", "Perhaps we should wait.", "That sounds sensible.", "Let us check again later."], ["d1", "d2", "d1", "d2", "d1"]),
    (["Did you see the new film?", "No, but I heard it was excellent."], ["d1", "d2"]),
    (["This room is much too cold.", "I will turn up the heating.", "Thank you, that helps."], ["d1", "d2", "d1"]),
    (["We need to leave early tomorrow.", "I have already packed my bag.", "Then everything is ready.", "Almost, I still need my passport."], ["d1", "d2", "d1", "d2"]),
    (["Can you help me with this problem?", "Of course, show me what you have tried."], ["d1", "d2"]),
    (["The shop was closed when I arrived.", "Maybe it opens later in the morning.", "I will come back after lunch."], ["d1", "d2", "d1"]),
]

def _quartiles(values):
    ordered = sorted(values)
    n = len(ordered)
    return (
        ordered[(n - 1) // 4],
        ordered[(n - 1) // 2],
        ordered[(3 * (n - 1)) // 4],
    )

def _quartile_index(value, bounds):
    if value <= bounds[0]:
        return 0
    if value <= bounds[1]:
        return 1
    if value <= bounds[2]:
        return 2
    return 3

def aug_code(train_data):
    augmented = list(train_data)
    lengths = [sum(len(turn.split()) for turn in row["context"]) for row in train_data]
    bounds = _quartiles(lengths) if lengths else (0, 0, 0)
    minimum = min(lengths) if lengths else 0
    maximum = max(lengths) if lengths else 0

    for row in train_data:
        recipient_context = row["context"]
        recipient_speakers = row["context_speakers"]
        recipient_length = sum(len(turn.split()) for turn in recipient_context)
        recipient_turns = len(recipient_context)
        recipient_quartile = _quartile_index(recipient_length, bounds)
        cast = list(dict.fromkeys([row["speaker"], *recipient_speakers]))

        candidates = []
        for snippet, snippet_speakers in _EXTERNAL_SNIPPETS:
            if len(snippet) != recipient_turns:
                continue
            if len(set(snippet_speakers)) > len(cast):
                continue
            snippet_length = sum(len(turn.split()) for turn in snippet)
            if snippet_length < minimum or snippet_length > maximum:
                continue
            if _quartile_index(snippet_length, bounds) != recipient_quartile:
                continue
            if snippet == recipient_context:
                continue
            candidates.append((snippet, snippet_speakers, snippet_length))

        if not candidates:
            continue

        nearest_distance = min(abs(candidate[2] - recipient_length) for candidate in candidates)
        candidates = [
            candidate for candidate in candidates
            if abs(candidate[2] - recipient_length) == nearest_distance
        ]
        snippet, snippet_speakers, _ = random.choice(candidates)

        mapping = {snippet_speakers[0]: row["speaker"]}
        remaining_cast = [name for name in cast if name != row["speaker"]]
        for donor_speaker in dict.fromkeys(snippet_speakers[1:]):
            if remaining_cast:
                mapping[donor_speaker] = remaining_cast.pop(0)

        prepared_speakers = [mapping[speaker] for speaker in snippet_speakers]
        for _ in range(3):
            rewritten = dict(row)
            rewritten["context"] = list(snippet)
            rewritten["context_speakers"] = prepared_speakers
            augmented.append(rewritten)

    return augmented
